title: Razer AI Creator Alpha
author: Razer-Plood
selftext:
**Hey everyone!**

**I’m from the Razer Software Team!** We’re launching the **Razer Creator Alpha**, and we’re looking for devs and creators to help us test some new AI-powered game development tools. If you want to experiment and help build something unique, sign up and join the program.

Lots of stuff is still under embargo so I can’t give too many details, but happy to answer, or pass any questions you have.

Also, as a bonus we’ll be giving out some gear to some of our early adopters! Sign up here: [https://www.razer.ai/creator-alpha/](https://www.razer.ai/creator-alpha/)
